address: Via Padre Giacinto 20, Palazzolo Acreide, 96010, Italy
bio: Recently relocated again within the historic centre, nothing has changed in substance in terms of both the direction of the cuisine and the tone of familiar hospitality and service. While Andrea is the cook, Sapori Montani already contains a foretaste of what you will find in the dishes: the homemade bread, pastas and desserts, the palazzolese sausage, the truffles – which have now made the locality famous throughout the island along with its Baroque churches and Greek theatre area – through trout, black piglet and excellent cheeses....
